entities.name: Colonial Charter on the Belgian annexation of the Congo Free State
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: The Colonial Charter on the Belgian annexation of the Congo Free State was approved by the Belgian Parliament on 18 October 1908. On 15 November 1908, Belgium assumed sovereignty over the territories comprising the Congo Free State, officially making the Belgian Congo a colony of Belgium.
